title: mirror-orphan-watch.yml has no alert step: scheduled failures ping nobody (PI-20261018-ORPHANWATCH-0001)
note: [2026-10-25 ROUTE-1025] Owns PI-20261018-ORPHANWATCH-0001. Also fold in: drop the two stale_ack entries from config/mirror_window_exclusions.yaml once PI-20261018-XRPORPHAN-0001 is decided (config edit: a lane may do it only if that decision is recorded).
